# Elastic Modulus Estimate

Category: mechanics

Estimate Young's modulus from a small synthetic stress-strain dataset.

import numpy as np

strain = np.array([0.0, 0.0005, 0.0010, 0.0015, 0.0020])
stress_mpa = np.array([0.0, 102.0, 205.0, 307.0, 410.0])
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(strain, stress_mpa, 1)
print('slope_MPa =', round(float(slope), 3))
print('intercept_MPa =', round(float(intercept), 3))
slope
